title: Asset export
idea: Asset export: Source artwork and export settings lead a named output preview
audience: People who need to export within a desktop surface.
worksWellWhen: Output dimensions and format affect usability
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its export priority and explicit commitment contract: Report actual created file paths and failures
navigation: Asset export keeps the current export context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Source artwork and export settings lead a named output preview
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to export; output dimensions and format affect usability
composition.priority: Report actual created file paths and failures

imagery.role: Support the actual export context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep summary dimensions next to export action
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the asset export structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no export content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Report actual created file paths and failures
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized export content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Report actual created file paths and failures
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active export context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
